notes:
Solo-performer recovery for the Philadelphia crawls (census_named, census_philly_north, census_philly_south_west). Window 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Every act on every raw listing was compared with all census_*.json rows for the same venue and date (name key ignores case, punctuation and a leading 'The'); only acts not already in the census were considered, and only one-person acts (own name or stage name, incl. rappers/producers performing live) were kept, on a date where the same venue also listed a band (census band, or a band in the raw listings, e.g. a Music Hall band the same night as a Lounge solo set at World Cafe Live) or where the show was part of a concert series (TileWorks 'A Night of Song in the Big Room'; Cedar Park Jazz).

Raw sources read: named/jb_all.jsonl, named/kfn_all.jsonl and named/sk/*.txt (Johnny Brenda's, Kung Fu Necktie: RockHouse lists, Wayback captures, Songkick); named/bsc.html (Black Squirrel live calendar); named/wbout/tw_*.html and tw2_*.html (TileWorks Wayback captures); named/wbout/moms_*.html and moms_le.json (MOM's: no solo acts with a band); pn/raw_apps.json (all north raw rows before the census filter: Songkick pages, pn/man/*.txt, MilkBoy schema.org/Tixr data); ua_events.json, wcl_events.json, wcl_manual.txt, chris_events.json, and the South/West pipe lists fuc.txt, fire.txt, rotunda.txt, ortliebs.txt, ruba.txt, gods.txt, cedar.txt; plus census billing strings for venues with no saved raw file (TLA, uCity Lawn, Clark Park, West Philly house show).
Could not use: named/sac.html (Starving Artist WordPress deleted), bit_sac.html (Bandsintown Cloudflare block), tw_products.json (rate-limited, empty), bsc_*.txt (GitHub 404 pages), tixr_batch.json (a browser script, not data). The First Unitarian, The Fire, Rotunda, Ruba, God's and Cedar 2026 pipe lists contain no solo acts beyond the census (solo names appear to have been removed before those lists were saved), so nothing was recoverable there. Chris' Jazz Cafe: no true solo sets found; per instruction, leader-billed groups count as bands, and vocalists billed alone, featured guests with a house trio/quartet, Jake Kaplan's hosted guest series, jams and school ensembles were all skipped.

Judgement calls: (1) When the only other act on the date was a census act that is itself one person (e.g. Ollie Wride, Brian Aubert, Cornelia Murr, Son Little, Dean Johnson, Hannah Cohen, Samantha Crain, June McDoom, Skullcrusher, Dreamer Isioma, Yuno, Bright Light Bright Light, Jed Harrelson, Ramsey Thornton, Landon Smith, Renee Christine, Clover), the bill was treated as having no band and the solo opener was left out. Bills with only an unidentifiable 'band' (Cardillo, Low Gap, OTNES, Sound of Jeb/Ecology: HomeStones, Sunbeam Sound Machine, The A Team) were also left out. (2) Duos billed as two names (e.g. Tyler Ramsey & Carl Broemel, Sam and Louise Sullivan, Ray and Paul) are not solo and were not counted as the band either; co-billed solo songwriters on a date with a band elsewhere in the venue were kept individually (Peter Case and Sid Griffin, Rhett Miller and Josh Rouse, Jeffrey Martin and Anna Tivel). (3) Person-name acts were taken as solo performers even when they may tour with a backing band (e.g. Ryley Walker, Liz Cooper, Becca Stevens, McKinley Dixon); one-person stage-name projects kept: JayWood, Automelodi, Stebmo, TŌTH, Zanias, Otay:onii, Gost, Swan Meat, Glomag, Ricky Eat Acid, Moor Mother, Pictureplane, Manic Focus, RJD2, Miss Grit, Girl Ultra, Sad13, Frances Forever, SOVEI, ABBIANA, Caiola. Unclear acts were skipped (e.g. Jaguar Sun, Time Wharp, Babehoven, Izzy True, Windser, Heffy, Det Cart Sid, Zaku, Nick Vivid, Billy Mac, Walt Lafty, gutter sinatra, Huston West). (4) Skipped: cancelled or postponed bills (Rachel Bobbitt with Jessica Lea Mayfield 2026-11-11, Ken Pomeroy 2026-05-07 postponed bill, Familiar Ghost 2025-09-07), DJs, dance/emo/drag/comedy/storytelling nights, open mics and jams, tribute nights, hosts (Joe Montone), featured guests inside a band's set (Ivy Sole etc. with BRTHWRK, Michael Jerome Browne with Eric Bibb, Emily Robb in The Frankensteins), Baby's First Rodeo nights with no band, West Philly Porchfest entirely. (5) Foundry: the census kept only local bands there; solo rows were added only on Foundry dates that have a census band, and the solo acts were not checked for being local. (6) Kev Walkman (PhilaMOCA listing) and Kevin Walkman (Foundry) are recorded under one name, Kevin Walkman. (7) Gretchen Elise (Cedar Park Jazz 2025-06-06) comes from the census venue record (coverage note says she was the named solo opener); the row reuses the census source URL, which covers the 2026 season, so the 2025 date is unverified from saved raw data. (8) source_type: Wayback/Tixr captures are 'archive'; Songkick and press items are 'aggregator' (the brief allows only venue_calendar/archive/aggregator).
